status.offline: Offline — changes stay on this device

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.emptyBody: Events, recurring plans and reminders will appear here.

todo.title: To-Do
todo.emptyBody: Notes and checklists you create will appear here.

kanban.title: Kanban
kanban.emptyBody: Boards with columns and cards will appear here.

trash.title: Trash
trash.emptyBody: Deleted items are kept here forever and can be restored.

setup.title: Welcome to Haalendar
setup.intro: Create the administrator account. You can invite other people afterwards.
setup.setupTokenHint: The value of HAALENDAR_SETUP_TOKEN from the server configuration.

errors.forbidden: The setup token is missing or invalid.
errors.alreadyDone: Setup has already been completed. Please sign in.
errors.duplicate: An account with this e-mail already exists.
errors.generic: Could not create the administrator. Please try again.
errors.offline: The server is unreachable. Check the connection and try again.

auth.name: Your name
auth.passwordHint: At least {{min}} characters. A passphrase of several words works well.

violations.contains_email: Do not include your e-mail address

auth.offline: The server is unreachable. Check the connection and try again.

login.title: Sign in to Haalendar
login.intro: Use the e-mail address and password of your account.
login.totpIntro: Two-factor authentication is on for this account.

errors.locked: Too many failed attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.unverified: Confirm your e-mail address first — check your inbox for the link.
errors.generic: Could not sign in. Please try again.

invite.title: Join Haalendar
invite.intro: You were invited. Choose your name and a password to create your account.
invite.invalidBody: This invitation link is invalid, was already used or has expired. Ask your administrator for a new one.
invite.alreadyExists: An account with this e-mail already exists. Sign in instead.

changePassword.title: Set a new password
changePassword.intro: You signed in with a one-time password. Choose your own password to continue.
changePassword.failed: The password could not be changed. Please try again.

reauth.title: Confirm it's you
reauth.description: This action is protected. Enter your password to continue.
reauth.wrong: The password or code is incorrect.
reauth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.

register.title: Create your account
register.intro: Choose your name and a password. We will send a link to confirm your e-mail address.
register.closedBody: New accounts on this instance are created by invitation. Ask your administrator.
register.checkBody: If {{email}} can be registered, a confirmation link is on its way. It is valid for 24 hours.
register.failed: The account could not be created. Please try again.

resend.sent: If the address belongs to an unconfirmed account, a new link was sent. Check your inbox.

verify.title: Confirming your e-mail
verify.doneBody: Your account is ready. You can sign in now.
verify.invalidBody: This confirmation link is invalid, was already used or has expired. Enter your e-mail address to get a new one.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter the e-mail address of your account. We will send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for {{email}}, a reset link is on its way. It is valid for one hour.
forgot.failed: The request could not be sent. Please try again.
forgot.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a few minutes and try again.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.intro: After saving you are signed out on all devices and sign in again with the new password.
reset.doneBody: Sign in with your new password.
reset.invalid: This reset link is invalid, was already used or has expired.

confirm.makeAdminBody: Administrators manage accounts and instance settings. They never see other people's calendars, notes or boards.
confirm.makeUserBody: The account loses access to the admin panel immediately.
confirm.deactivateBody: The account is signed out everywhere and can no longer sign in. Nothing is deleted — you can reactivate it at any time.
confirm.resetBody: The account is signed out everywhere. A reset link is e-mailed, or — without an e-mail server — you receive a one-time password to hand over.

results.deactivate: {{name}} was deactivated and signed out. Their data is kept.
results.resetEmail: A password reset link was sent to {{email}}.

oneTime.title: One-time password
oneTime.body: Give this password to {{email}} over a safe channel.
oneTime.label: One-time password
oneTime.once: It is shown only once and must be replaced at the first sign-in.

invite.title: Invite a user
invite.intro: An invitation link valid for 7 days is e-mailed. Without an e-mail server the account is created at once with a one-time password.
invite.name: Name (optional)
invite.nameHint: Used when the account is created without an e-mail server.
invite.duplicate: An account with this e-mail already exists.

invites.title: Pending invitations
invites.confirmBody: The link sent to {{email}} stops working.

errors.generic: The change could not be saved. Please try again.
errors.lastAdmin: Not possible: at least one active administrator must remain.
errors.reactivateFirst: Reactivate the account before resetting its password.
errors.changedMeanwhile: The user was changed meanwhile. The list has been refreshed — please try again.
errors.notFound: This user no longer exists. The list has been refreshed.
errors.totpRequired: This instance requires two-factor authentication for administrators. Enable it in your account first.
errors.reauthFailed: Your identity could not be confirmed.

instance.title: Instance
instance.ownTfaFirst: Turn on two-factor authentication for your own account first (Settings → Security).
instance.smtpOff: E-mail sending is not configured: invitations and resets use one-time passwords.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Display name
profile.conflict: Your profile was changed elsewhere. The latest version is shown — please check and save again.
profile.failed: The profile could not be saved. Please try again.
profile.offline: Changing the profile needs a connection to the server.
profile.avatarHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB. It is cropped to a square and location data is removed.
profile.avatarType: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
profile.avatarSize: The image must not exceed 2 MB.

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.noneByMe: You have not shared anything yet.
sharing.noneWithMe: Nothing has been shared with you yet.
sharing.dialogIntro: People you share with see it in their app. Editors can change its contents but not rename, delete or share it.

errors.userNotFound: There is no user with this e-mail address on this instance.
errors.duplicate: This person already has access — change the permission below.
errors.notFound: This share no longer exists. The list has been refreshed.
errors.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change sharing.
errors.changedMeanwhile: The share was changed meanwhile. The list has been refreshed — please try again.
errors.generic: The change could not be saved. Please try again.
errors.offline: Sharing needs a connection to the server.

timeZone.mismatch: This device is set to {{device}}, your profile to {{profile}}. Times are shown in {{profile}}.
timeZone.failed: The time zone could not be changed. Try again in Settings → Profile.

password.title: Change password
password.done: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
password.failed: The password could not be changed.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.on: On — signing in needs a code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.off: Off — protect your account with an authenticator app.
twoFactor.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
twoFactor.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.wrongCode: The code is incorrect. Check the time on your phone and try again.
twoFactor.adminRequired: This instance requires two-factor authentication for administrators.
twoFactor.failed: The change could not be saved. Please try again.

codes.title: Recovery codes
codes.body: Each code signs you in once if you lose your phone. Store them somewhere safe — they are shown only now.

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.othersRevoked: All other devices were signed out.
sessions.failed: The device could not be signed out.
